title: F25 · the_report · Waiting for the Report
lines: Token seventeen. The board says fifteen.
The doctor said, Probably nothing. Let us check.
The doctor said, "Probably nothing. Let us check."
In one hour, their life could be the same, or completely different.
His mind has already lived through every bad ending.
The man on the next chair was holding a small pouch of ash from a temple.
Everyone in this corridor has the same amount of time. Now.
Papa stopped looking at the board.
He looked at his wife's hand, and took it.
You cannot live the next hour yet. Live this one. That is sadhana.
